title: Meat production summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Rosado, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): global meat production more than quadrupled since 1961 to >350 million tonnes (from ~80 million); Asia up ~15-fold, Europe roughly doubled; poultry now over a third of the total. Figures/derivations verified consistent (350/80 ~ 4.4x; 15/2 ~ 7.5x) before injecting 3 defects.
